title: List the projects
prompt: Return the name and started_on of every project, in that column order.
hints: Which table holds projects, and what are its columns called?
List the two columns after SELECT, separated by a comma, then name the table after FROM.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Lists the columns in the wrong order.
Returns every column instead of the two that were asked for.

feedback: Compare the first line of your result with the prompt. The columns must be the ones asked for, in that order.
